messages:
sam (PM): quick thread: customer Q asked for a "graduated retirement" option — they want to move off an old catalog entry but keep a small fraction on the legacy path for 45d while we measure. what minimal pieces do we need to ship?
toni (Eng): propose: per-tenant retirement_policy with fields: start_date, grace_days, legacy_pct, auto_unpin=false. runtime routes X% of tenant traffic to legacy model during grace.
lee (Research): measurement needs: paired examples (1k min), stratify by prompt length + intent. collect: embed_cosine, token_logprob_delta, and a tiny human spot-check (20 prompts).
alan (CS): CS asks for console affordances: show "expected end date", ability to extend by +15/30 days, and a CSV of tenants still on legacy. also want clear customer-facing email template.
toni (Eng): rollout safety: circuit-breaker on per-tenant error_rate and cohort-wide embed_drop. config sketch:
```
retirement_policy: {grace_days:45, legacy_pct:5, auto_unpin:false, rollback_triggers:["error_rate>0.5%","embed_drop>0.07"]}
```
ops-bot: scheduled canary: legacy-path -> internal-beta at 2026-07-12T02:00:00Z. monitors: p95_latency, error_rate, embed_cosine_median.
lee (Research): pass/fail thresholds: embed_cos_mean >= 0.94 AND logprob_delta between -0.1..+0.06. if fail -> tag failing prompts and surface top 10 examples in UI.
toni (Eng): automation: if any rollback trigger fires for >10m, pause retirement and open a runbook ticket. also provide `rctl pin extend --tenant TENANT --days N` for CS.
alan (CS): we need opt-out record per tenant (who approved, timestamp) for audits. include this in export.
sam (PM): ok action list: (1) Eng: implement policy + extend CLI (toni), (2) Research: canonical sample set + thresholds (lee), (3) CS: email copy + export layout (alan), (4) Ops: dashboards + runbook wiring (ops). follow-up sync Wed 9am.
